final.title: Request for additional visa extension documents
steps: Prepare a job-seeking activity plan (구직활동계획서) for the next 6 months, signed by you.
Prepare proof of residence (체류지 입증서류): a copy of your lease contract or a confirmation of accommodation.
Prepare a bank balance certificate (잔고증명서) in your own name, issued within the last 1 month.

Submit all three documents by December 11, 2026, either by uploading them to the HiKorea e-petition system (하이코리아 전자민원) or by visiting the 3rd-floor Stay Management Division counter (3층 체류관리과 창구) in person.
If you submit in person, bring this notice and your passport.
If you cannot submit the documents by December 11, 2026, submit a written explanation (사유서) before the deadline to request a one-time extension.
final.if_ignored: If you do not submit the documents by the deadline, your application will be reviewed using only the documents already submitted and may be denied. If denied, you may face penalties under South Korean immigration law.
corrected: read as "입대계약서서 또는 소속제공 확인서", understood as "임대차계약서 사본 또는 숙소제공 확인서" (copy of lease contract or confirmation of accommodation)
read as "사무관리과", understood as "체류관리과" (Stay Management Division)
read as "이 수서와 여권", understood as "이 요구서와 여권" (this notice and passport)
read as "보지 못하면", understood as "보완하지 않으면" (if you do not supplement/submit)
read as "외국인총괄센터", understood as "외국인종합안내센터" (Foreigner General Information Center)

explained.title: Request for missing documents for visa extension
steps: Prepare an activity plan for job hunting (구직활동계획서) for the next 6 months with your signature.
Prepare a proof of residence document such as a lease agreement copy or a provider confirmation (체류지 증명서 / 체류지 입증서류).
Prepare a balance certificate (잔고증명서) in your name issued within the last 1 month.
Submit these documents by December 11, 2026 by uploading them on the HiKorea electronic civil petition website or by visiting the 3rd floor office window with this notice and your passport.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not submit the documents by the deadline, your extension application may be denied based only on the currently submitted documents, and you may be penalized according to Korean law.

final.title: Advance notice of parking violation fine
steps: Pay 96,000원 by December 22, 2026, using virtual account 612-907-33182-04 (account holder: 수원시영통구청), Wetax, or ARS 1588-0110.
If you were not the driver, submit a driver confirmation form by December 22, 2026, so the fine is charged to the actual driver.
final.objection: If you have an objection, submit a written statement of opinion and supporting documents by December 22, 2026; if you do not, it will be treated as having no objection.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay by the deadline, the full fine of 120,000원 will be formally charged, with a 3% late fee and monthly additional fees up to 75%; continued non-payment can lead to confiscation of your vehicle's license plate or seizure of your property.

final.title: Court payment order for unpaid loan
steps: Pay 인천광역시 남동구 인하로 501, 803 동 1204호 the loan principal of 4,800,000원, plus 86,300원 in procedure costs and late interest (5% per year from November 21, 2026 to November 30, 2026, and 12% per year after that until paid in full).

If you disagree with the claim or have already paid, file an objection (이의신청) by December 14, 2026 at the Incheon District Court Civil Application Division or through the Electronic Litigation website.
Even if you pay the full amount claimed, get a written settlement agreement (합의서) from 인천광역시 남동구 인하로 501, 803 동 1204호.
final.objection: You can file an objection within 2 weeks of the service date (by December 14, 2026, based on the November 30, 2026 service date) at the Incheon District Court Civil Application Division or on the Electronic Litigation website. If you object, the case will move to regular court litigation.

steps: Pay the amount of 744,780원 by December 21, 2026.

You can pay at the hospital administration payment window, through the hospital app, or by transferring the money to the patient-exclusive virtual account 471-0293-8274-11 (예금주: 한빛대학교병원) using your patient number 01938274 as the depositor name.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not pay by the deadline, a 6% annual late interest fee will be added, and you will be asked to settle the unpaid amount first when booking your next hospital visit. If unpaid for 30 days after the deadline, the hospital may begin debt collection procedures or apply for a payment order.
corrected: read as "남부담할 금액", understood as "남은 부담할 금액" (remaining amount to pay)
read as "금연 본인부담", understood as "급여 본인부담" (covered patient burden)
read as "신결료", understood as "식대" (meal costs)

final.title: Overdue water bill and shutoff warning
steps: Pay 156,890원 by December 15, 2026.
You can pay by transferring to virtual account 309-1121-0738-44 (account holder: 부산상수도사업본부), online or via the app using notice number B-2026-12-0061583, or by phone (ARS) at 1588-0121 using a card.
If you have already paid, keep your receipt and contact the billing division at 051-669-5732 to confirm.
final.objection: You can file a written objection within 14 days of receiving this notice if you disagree with the usage or bill calculation; shutoff is paused during the review. Basic livelihood recipients, single-person households aged 65 or older, and households with infants can apply for a shutoff deferral. If high usage was caused by a leak, you can submit a repair receipt for a bill reduction.
final.if_ignored: Your water supply will be shut off on December 17, 2026, without further notice. To restore water, you will have to pay the full overdue amount (or the first installment of a payment plan) plus a 10,000원 reconnection fee. final.title: Request for additional visa renewal documents
steps: Obtain your residence tax taxation certificate and tax payment certificate for the most recent 1 year from your ward office.
Obtain a certificate of employment issued by your employer on or after December 1, 2026.
Obtain a certificate detailing your specific job duties, signed by a representative of your employer.
Make a copy of this notice and place it on top of the other documents.
Attach a Japanese translation to any document written in a foreign language.

Submit all documents by December 18, 2026, either in person at the bureau counter, by simplified registered mail with "資料提出 2026-T-0584621" written in red on the envelope, or through the Residence Application Online System if you applied online.
If you cannot submit the documents by December 18, 2026, contact the office at 03-5796-7111 before the deadline.
final.if_ignored: Your application will be reviewed using only the documents already submitted, and as a result, your application may be denied.

explained.title: Notice to submit documents for visa renewal
steps: Obtain a resident tax taxation certificate and tax payment certificate for the most recent year from the ward office.
Obtain a certificate of employment created by your employer on or after December 1, 2026.
Obtain a certificate detailing your job duties, signed by your employer's representative.
Make a copy of this notice letter and place it on top of your submission documents.

Submit the documents to the counter of the designated department by the deadline, or mail them by registered mail (write "資料提出 2026-T-0584621" in red on the front of the envelope), or submit them online via the residence application online system.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not submit the documents by the deadline, the review will be conducted using only the documents currently submitted, which may result in your application being denied.

final.objection: You can file a request for review (審査請求) with the National Public Safety Commission within 3 months from the day after you learned of this order. If the driver pays the traffic fine, this order will be canceled.

final.title: Court payment order for unpaid loan
steps: Pay 398,084円 (plus additional late damages at 14.6% per year on the 392,500円 principal from December 1, 2026 until paid in full) directly to the creditor, Soratomo Finance Co., Ltd. Do not pay the court.

Alternatively, if you dispute the claim or wish to request installment payments, fill out the enclosed objection form (督促異議申立書) and submit it to the Tokyo Summary Court in person or by mail by December 17, 2026 (within 2 weeks of receiving this order).
final.objection: Submit the enclosed objection form (督促異議申立書) to the Tokyo Summary Court (in person or by mail) by December 17, 2026. Filing an objection moves the case to regular court proceedings at a court near your address, and you can also request installment payments on the form.
final.if_ignored: If you neither pay nor file an objection within 2 weeks of receiving this order, the court will issue a declaration of provisional execution at the creditor's request, allowing them to seize your salary, bank deposits, or other assets.
corrected: read as "管理異動の申立", understood as "督促異議の申立" (filing an objection to the payment order)
read as "仮財産官", understood as "仮執行宣言" (declaration of provisional execution)
read as "預落金", understood as "給料預金等" (salary, bank deposits, etc.)
read as "分別のない希望", understood as "分割払の希望" (request for installment payments)
read as "消費まで", understood as "完済まで" (until full payment)
read as "管控係", understood as "督促係" (Payment Order Section)

If you pay by bank transfer, enter your patient number 0074-3381 before your name as the sender (for example: 00743381 プトリ アレスタリ), and pay the bank transfer fee yourself.

final.title: Notice of upcoming water shutoff for unpaid bill
steps: Pay 12,496円 by January 19, 2027 using the enclosed payment slip at a bank, post office, convenience store, or via smartphone payment.

If you cannot pay by the deadline or need to arrange installment payments or special consideration, call the Chubu Billing Center Water Shutoff Desk at 045-671-3058 (weekdays 8:45–17:00) before January 19, 2027.
If your water is shut off and you pay the overdue amount afterward, keep your receipt and call 045-671-3058 (or 045-671-3099 at night or on holidays) to request reconnection.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay by January 19, 2027, staff will shut off your water meter valve on or after January 26, 2027, even if you are not home. You will still owe the unpaid charges, and legal collection measures may be taken.

final.title: Parking fine for driving in a bus lane
steps: Pay £80.00 by 15/12/2026 online at www.camden.gov.uk/parking using PCN number CU81234567 and vehicle registration LK19 XWD, or call the automated line 020 7974 4646.
If you were not the keeper of the vehicle on 21/11/2026, tell the council within 28 days of 25/11/2026 and give the keeper's name and address.
final.objection: If you think you do not owe the fine, you can make representations within 28 days of 25/11/2026 (by 22/12/2026). If you challenge it within 21 days (by 15/12/2026), the £80.00 discount will be held until they reply.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or challenge the fine within 28 days of 25/11/2026, the council may issue a Charge Certificate and increase the fine to £240.00. If you still do not pay, the council may register the debt at the Traffic Enforcement Centre and send enforcement agents to recover it.

final.title: Speeding fine from traffic authority
steps: Pay the reduced fine of 150,00 € by December 21, 2026, at sede.dgt.gob.es, by calling 060, or at any Traffic Office (Jefatura de Tráfico), quoting case number 2904 5 26 0817 33.
If you were not the driver, identify the driver within 20 calendar days of December 1, 2026 (by December 21, 2026).
final.objection: You can submit objections (alegaciones) within 20 calendar days of notification (by December 21, 2026). Paying the reduced amount of 150,00 € waives your right to submit objections.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or submit objections within 30 calendar days, this notice becomes a final sanctioning resolution. You will have to pay the full amount of 300,00 €, and if you still do not pay, it will be collected through enforced collection with an additional surcharge. If you were not the driver and fail to identify them, you can be fined double or triple the original fine.

explained.title: Traffic fine notification
steps: Pay the reduced amount of 150,00 € by December 21, 2026, online at sede.dgt.gob.es, by calling 060, or at any Traffic Headquarters, indicating file number 2904 5 26 0817 33.
Alternatively, if you were not the driver, identify the actual driver within 20 calendar days.
Alternatively, present allegations within 20 calendar days if you wish to dispute the fine.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not pay or present allegations, the notification will take effect as a sanction resolution after 30 calendar days, requiring you to pay the full amount of 300,00 €, after which it will be collected through enforcement proceedings with a corresponding surcharge. Failing to identify the driver is sanctioned with double or triple the fine.

final.title: Court order to pay unpaid rent
steps: Pay 3.946,50 € by January 13, 2027 into the court's deposit account: IBAN ES17 5391 0802 6740 0028 3311 with reference 2533 0000 66 1873 26.
Provide proof of payment to the court before January 13, 2027 so the case can be closed.
Or, if you believe you do not owe this money, file a written objection signed by a lawyer and a court representative (procurador) by January 13, 2027.
final.objection: You can file a written objection by January 13, 2027 explaining why you do not owe the money. Because the claim is over 2.000 euros, the objection must be signed by both a lawyer and a court representative (procurador). If you cannot afford a lawyer, you can apply for free legal aid at the Madrid Bar Association (Colegio de Abogados de Madrid).
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or appear before the court by the deadline, the court will close the payment order process and D. Fernando Aguirre Salcedo can request enforcement, which includes seizing your assets, bank accounts, and wages.

explained.title: Court payment order for unpaid rent
steps: Pay the amount of 3.946,50 € into the Court Deposits and Consignations Account with IBAN ES17 5391 0802 6740 0028 3311 and reference 2533 0000 66 1873 26 by January 13, 2027.
Alternatively, if you disagree with the debt, file a written opposition signed by a lawyer and a court representative (procurador) by January 13, 2027.
If you cannot afford a lawyer, you can apply for free legal aid at the Madrid Bar Association (Colegio de Abogados de Madrid).
explained.if_ignored: If you neither pay nor appear within the deadline, the court will end the monitor process and the petitioner can request enforcement, which includes the seizure of your property, bank accounts, and wages.

final.title: Overdue self-employed social security debt claim
steps: Pay 705,60 € by December 31, 2026 at any authorized bank using payment reference 41 26 0 112839452 7, or online through the Import@ss service of the Social Security Electronic Headquarters.
If you cannot pay on time, you can apply for a payment deferral before December 31, 2026.
final.objection: You can file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Provincial Directorate within one month from the day after you receive this notice. Filing an appeal does not stop the collection process unless you guarantee or deposit the debt amount.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay by the deadline, an enforcement order will be issued with a 20% surcharge, and seizure of your assets, bank accounts, and credits will begin, plus any costs. Unpaid contributions can also prevent you from receiving benefits such as temporary disability or cessation of activity.

steps: Pay $ 155.233,25 by December 22, 2026 to avoid disconnection.
